title: Roofing Quote Stall Rescue Board
oneLiner: A sales-ops board for roofing companies that surfaces estimate deals likely to die because inspection follow-up, financing, or insurance paperwork stalled.
targetUser: Roofing company owners, sales coordinators, and office managers handling residential estimate pipelines.
keyUX: Review high-value stalled quotes, inspect why each job stopped moving, and trigger the fastest rescue action from one board.
stitchPrompt: Design a desktop sales-operations dashboard called Roofing Quote Stall Rescue Board for roofing company owners and coordinators. It should help teams rescue high-value residential estimates by combining quote age, inspection status, financing readiness, insurance paperwork blockers, and recommended next actions in one workspace. Include a pipeline rescue KPI header, a stalled quote priority board, an inspection-to-close funnel chart, a financing and insurance blocker panel, a homeowner timeline, and a next-best-action composer. Design direction: use an operator-dense control-room style with compact information layout, strong hierarchy, dark slate surfaces, bright status coding, and crisp data modules that make urgency obvious at a glance.
